claims.claim: Reading a table needs USE CATALOG, USE SCHEMA and SELECT; MODIFY needs SELECT and both USE privileges; privileges granted on a schema are inherited by current and future tables.
GRANT accepts a comma-separated list of privileges, and SHOW GRANTS lists grants on a securable.

concept_html:
Unity Catalog controls access with privileges on securable objects. Four privileges cover most pipeline work:

Privilege On Lets the principal
USE CATALOG catalog see into the catalog. Grants no data access by itself.
USE SCHEMA schema see into the schema. Grants no data access by itself.
SELECT table, or schema read data
MODIFY table, or schema insert, update and delete data

To read a table, a principal needs all three: USE CATALOG on its catalog, USE SCHEMA on its schema and SELECT on the table. MODIFY also needs SELECT and both USE privileges.

Grant at the container. A privilege granted on a schema is inherited by every current and future table in it. GRANT SELECT ON SCHEMA research_prod.research_gold covers next month's new gold table without another ticket.

Grant to groups, never to individual users. People join, move and leave. A group grant is managed once, in one place. A user grant outlives the reason it was made, and nobody finds it until an audit.

Run pipelines as a service principal. Jobs that write bronze, silver and gold run as a service principal with MODIFY on those schemas. People get SELECT on the layers they need, and no person needs MODIFY on production.

GRANT USE CATALOG ON CATALOG research_prod TO `research_analysts`;
GRANT USE SCHEMA, SELECT ON SCHEMA research_prod.research_gold TO `research_analysts`;
SHOW GRANTS ON SCHEMA research_prod.research_gold;

Avoid ALL PRIVILEGES outside sandboxes. It includes privileges you did not think about, and future privileges too.

GRANT USE CATALOG ON CATALOG research_prod TO `research-pipeline-sp`;
GRANT USE SCHEMA, SELECT, MODIFY ON SCHEMA research_prod.research_silver TO `research-pipeline-sp`;
GRANT USE SCHEMA, SELECT, MODIFY ON SCHEMA research_prod.research_gold TO `research-pipeline-sp`;
-- Check what is in place.
SHOW GRANTS ON SCHEMA research_prod.research_gold;

title: Grant to groups, grant the least, grant at the right level
why_html:
During a deadline, an analyst gets MODIFY on research_prod.research_silver "for one day" to patch a mapping by hand. The grant is to their user account. Eight months later they run a clean-up notebook against what they believe is a dev copy and delete 12,000 silver rows. Nobody remembered the grant, and silver had to be rebuilt from bronze.

With the rule "people get SELECT, pipelines get MODIFY, grants go to groups", the patch would have gone through the pipeline, and the delete would have failed with a permission error.
